name: Southern Patagonia
region: Chaltén massif (Fitz Roy, Cerro Torre) on the edge of the Southern Patagonian Icefield.
sources: Garreaud, R. et al. (2013) Large-scale control on the Patagonian climate. Journal of Climate 26
Lenaerts, J. et al. (2014) Extreme precipitation and climate gradients in Patagonia revealed by high-resolution regional atmospheric climate modeling. Journal of Climate 27
Hersbach, H. et al. (2020) The ERA5 global reanalysis. QJRMS 146:1999-2049 (monthly climatology 1991-2020, 300 hPa winds)
notes: Relentless westerlies; climbable windows are short (often 1-3 days) and come between frontal systems.
